certified_services.serviceDescription: Sign-in, registration, account recovery, and configured authentication flows.
Supported federation, single sign-on, and application authentication.
Identity profiles, account lifecycle, roles, and self-service account management.
Identity provisioning and synchronization through approved connectors.
Application configuration, administrative interfaces, APIs, and service accounts.
Customer-accessible identity audit records and log retrieval.

current.service_desc: Ping Government Identity Cloud is Ping Identity Corporation's SaaS identity and access management offering serving government and nongovernment customers. The proposed FedRAMP scope covers authentication journeys, federation and single sign-on, identity lifecycle management, provisioning and synchronization, application and tenant administration, and audit and logging across Development, Staging, and Production environments. Ping is pursuing FedRAMP 20x Class C certification.
